name: Shockwave
description: Launches a wave that damages pulls and slows enemies

name: Skewer
description: Dashes forward dragging enemies along and slowing them at the end

name: Frost Lance
description: Homing lance; splashes and chills enemies near the target

name: War Cry
description: Empowers the caster and nearby allies and knocks enemies back

name: Mending Beam
description: Channel to heal; an interrupted channel heals less

name: Lunge
description: A quick dash toward the target point

name: Bull Rush
description: Charges the target and stuns it on arrival

name: Meat Hook
description: Throws a hook that pulls the first enemy it hits to the caster

name: Twister
description: Lifts an enemy unit into the air where nothing can touch it

name: Snare Field
description: Confines enemies in the area to a circle around the target point

name: Chain Link
description: Tethers an enemy to the caster
